name: kaocid
description: TB-303 style acid bass with auto legato phrase generator for NTS-3. Hold pad to play a tempo-synced 16-step tied line with glides. Touch again to regenerate. X = Cutoff, Y = Resonance, Depth = mix. Voice inspired by Andy Sloane gsynth TB-303 (2001 abandonware).

params.name: DEC
params.detail: Filter envelope decay (~200 ms to 2.5 s)
